Package pt.pa.controller

Class MapController

java.lang.Object
pt.pa.controller.TransportBaseController
pt.pa.controller.MapController
public class MapController extends TransportBaseController

      public void doMarkRoutes(Collection<org.javatuples.Pair<com.brunomnsilva.smartgraph.graph.Edge<Route,Stop>,CostType>> selectedRoutes)
      Marks routes in the map with a collection of edge routes and their preferred cost type.

    • doMarkRoutesWithDelay

      public void doMarkRoutesWithDelay(Collection<org.javatuples.Quartet<com.brunomnsilva.smartgraph.graph.Edge<Route,Stop>,String,TransportColor,Double>> path)
      Marks the routes in the given path with a delay, while reducing the opacity of other routes. The path is represented by a collection of triplets, each containing an edge (route), a color, and a delay value for marking the route.
      Parameters:
      path - A collection of triplets representing the edges (routes) to be marked, along with the associated color and delay for each route.
